title: Make Money With This New AI Agent That Works 24/7
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: Plugs his paid playmakers.ai community; demo of the AI agent tool (says not sponsored)

stated_problem.quote: Not my thing, but it's hard for me to be accountable to a calendar event that no other human is a part of, right?
stated_problem.speaker: Chris Koerner

idea.name: Morning Lock: scheduled inbox/app blocker SaaS
idea.one_liner: Mac menu bar app plus Chrome extension that locks email and distracting sites outside a set window (e.g. 5-10am), unlockable only with a password held by a spouse, built by an AI agent and sold as SaaS via Stripe
idea.customer: knowledge workers and founders struggling with email/distraction

key_quotes.quote: My idea is to lock me out of my inbox for the majority of the day, so I have to get caught up on my emails in a specific time frame.
So, I can lock in and then I can even send my password to a spouse, a loved one, whatever, so they have to be the one to unlock it for me.

claims.claim: Working Chrome extension built in ~31 minutes of recording
claims.quote: You're seeing the edited version, but it's only been recording for 31 minutes and 37 seconds.

ideas.delivery: AI agent prompted (prompt drafted by Claude) to build, test and fix in Replit/GitHub; Stripe for payments; Apple developer and Chrome Web Store accounts set up manually
